verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Rootly serves a live llms.txt at docs.rootly.com/llms.txt with an LLM-oriented product summary. The docs are also published as raw .md pages, which an agent can read directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining the llms.txt or agent-docs offering (e.g., an llms-full.txt or guidance for agents), and independent corroboration of how well agents consume it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
